Nanotechnology Research and Advanced Applications at AVIT
Learn about nanotechnology research at AVIT focused on advanced materials, innovation, and emerging scientific applications.
Centre for Nanotechnology Research
Scope
Aim to advance the field of nanotechnology through innovative research, collaboration, and publications in highly reputed journals.
Focus on the practical applications of Nanotechnology in Materials science, healthcare, food, energy, environmental sustainability, and agriculture. Conduct effective and efficient research that addresses the needs of society.
Interdisciplinary hub- Serve as an interdisciplinary hub bridging engineering, biosciences, and medicine to provide consultancy, technology transfer, and industry solutions.
Vision
To establish the Centre for Nanotechnology Research (CNR) as a globally recognized hub for innovative research in nanotechnology, addressing societal needs in health, sustainability, and industry through ethical scientific advancements.
Dr. Suganya Josephine G A
Assistant Professor
Dr. Suganya Josephine G. A. is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Chemistry at Aarupadai Veedu Institute of Technology (AVIT), Vinayaka Mission Research Foundation, Chennai. She holds a Ph.D. in Chemistry from CSIR–Central Leather Research Institute (CLRI) and has also served as a CSIR Research Associate. Her research interests include semiconductor nanomaterials, photocatalysis, and environmental remediation. She has published extensively in reputed international journals, holds a granted patent, and actively guides Ph.D. scholars at VMRF.
LinkedIn Profile
Dr. M. Surendiran
Associate Professor
Dr. M. Surendiran is an Associate Professor whose research spans nanobiomaterials, corrosion science, sustainable materials, and bio-ceramic coatings for biomedical and engineering applications. He has published extensively in high-impact international journals, holds multiple patents, and has secured competitive funding from UGC, VMRF (DU), and Tamil Nadu state agencies. His academic leadership includes research administration, NAAC accreditation, and doctoral mentoring, with a strong focus on translational and impact-driven materials research. He also has international research experience as a Visiting Scientist at the National Institute for Materials Science (NIMS), Japan.
LinkedIn Profile
Dr. G. Suresh
Associate Professor
Dr. G. Suresh is an Associate Professor with over 17 years of teaching and 19 years of research experience. His research focuses on nanostructured biomaterials, polymeric nanocomposites, environmental toxicology, and photocatalytic materials, with more than 65 international journal publications, an h-index of 20, and recognition as a World Top 2% Scientist. He is an approved PhD supervisor at VMRF(DU), Anna University, Bharathiar University, and Annamalai University, has led funded national and international research projects, and actively collaborates with global research groups, emphasizing high-impact, application-oriented materials research.
LinkedIn Profile
Dr. Shajahan Azeez
Associate Professor Cum Assistant Director
Dr. Shajahan is Associate Professor and Assistant Director at the Center for Nanotechnology Research, AVIT. He holds PhD from the University of Madras, with research focused on chitosan-based nanomaterials and biotechnological applications, and completed postdoctoral research at the Entomology Research Institute on plant-based nanobotanical pesticide development. He is actively involved in collaborative research at the Department of Microbiology and Biotechnology (DMBT), AVMC, Puducherry, and is engaged in mentoring and guiding PhD scholars. His research interests include biomaterials, nanobiotechnology, polymeric drug delivery systems, and wound healing materials, supported by national and international collaborations with an emphasis on Q1–Q2 journal publications.

Dr. S. P. Sangeetha
About
Dr. S. P. Sangeetha is a distinguished academic leader with over two decades of experience in teaching, research, and academic administration. She currently serves as Vice Principal (Academics) and Professor in the Department of Civil Engineering, and as the Dean of Engineering and Technology at VMRF. She has been associated with AVIT since 2011, contributing extensively to various academic and administrative capacities. She is the Program Director of the Institutional Social Responsibility (ISR) Cell and Convener of the Women Empowerment Cell, actively promoting community engagement and inclusive development. Known for her strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills, she has organized numerous national and international conferences, workshops, seminars, and guest lectures for students and faculty. She also leads skill development initiatives that support self-employment opportunities, particularly for rural women. Dr. Sangeetha is an active member of several professional bodies. She also maintains strong collaborations with construction industries and academic institutions.
Qualification and Research Interests
Dr. Sangeetha is a Civil Engineer with a specialization in Structural Engineering. Her research areas include Concrete Technology; Structural Design; Rehabilitation of Concrete Structures and Sustainable Construction Practices. She delivers expert lectures in academic institutions and industry forums. She has also authored textbooks and book chapters. Her scholarly record includes over 70 research publications in Scopus-indexed, Web of Science, and peer-reviewed journals. She also holds eight granted patents.
Awards and Recognitions
Dr. Sangeetha has received several awards in recognition of her academic leadership, teaching excellence, and social contributions. These include the Education Leadership Award (2022) from Glantor X Pvt. Ltd., the VMRF Women Leadership Award (2021), the Young Dynamic Woman Performer of the Year Award (2020) from Global Awards, and the Manitha Neyam Award (2020) from Alaigal Foundation for her services in villages during the COVID-19 pandemic. She has also received the Academic Leadership Award (2021) from the International Glad Heads Up Awards, the South Indian Women Achiever Award (2019), the Best Teaching Faculty Award from DKIRF, the Recognition Faculty Award from the Rotary Club in 2019 and 2020, and the Best Faculty Coordinator Award in 2021,2022 &2023. She is a certified Lead Auditor recognized by Nature Science Foundations. She serves as a reviewer and in the editorial board for several journals and has been part of advisory and technical committees at national and international conferences. Additionally, she has served as a Subject Expert for the Student Learning Assessment Preparation (SLAP) initiative under AICTE and as an evaluator for Toycathon and Smart India Hackathon organized by the Government of India.

SOURCE: https://avit.ac.in/department-of-hs-highlights
Humanities and Sciences Department Highlights at AVIT
Discover highlights from the Humanities and Sciences department showcasing academic activities, student achievements, and interdisciplinary learning initiatives.
Department of Humanities and Science - Highlights
Research Areas
The research explores Indian Writing in English, Feminism, Ecofeminism, English Language Teaching (ELT), and Children’s Literature. It emphasizes the integration of feminist and ecofeminist perspectives in literary analysis and language education, encouraging gender-conscious curricula and critical pedagogical approaches that bridge literature, culture, and social justice.
The scientific research engages deeply in Synthetic Chemistry, Electrochemistry, Nanomaterials, and Semiconductor Nanostructures. Focus areas include Nanostructured Biomaterials, Polymeric Nanocomposites, Metal–Organic Frameworks (MOFs), and Thin Films for diverse applications in energy storage, sensing, catalysis, and environmental protection.
Additionally, the work extends to Photocatalysis, Heterogeneous Catalysis, Energy Storage Devices, Environmental Remediation, Water Treatment, and Self-Cleaning Textiles, integrating materials design with sustainable and technological innovations.
The work examines Thin-Film Physics, Semiconductor Nanostructures, and Energy Materials for sensing and environmental systems. It studies crystal growth mechanisms, charge transport dynamics, and photoelectronic properties relevant to renewable energy and sensor development. Applications include photocatalytic systems, electronic-nose devices, and environment-oriented nanostructured materials that combine physical modelling with experimental validation.
The mathematical component of the research involves Graph Theory (including Crossing Numbers and Graph Labelling), Dynamic Equations on Time Scales, and Transform Techniques in Bicomplex Space. It further includes mathematical modelling of biological systems using Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) and computational simulations of complex systems such as electrochemical reactions, Corrosion processes, Nanobiomaterials, and Fluid Dynamics using MATLAB.The integration of AI-driven modelling and Computer-Aided Drug Discovery (CADD) methods reflects a cross-disciplinary application of mathematical algorithms to drug design and pattern-recognition systems like electronic-nose technologies for early cancer detection.

Head of Mechanical Engineering Department at AVIT
Get to know the Head of the Mechanical Engineering department and the academic initiatives that strengthen hands-on learning and technical excellence.
HOD Mechanical Engineering
Dr. M. PRABHAHAR
Dr. M. PRABHAHAR was joined in AVIT as a Lecturer on August 2005. Later, he was promoted into various roles and presently positioned as a Professor and Head of the Department of Mechanical Engineering, Aarupadai Veedu Institute of Technology, Paiyanoor, India.
Professor and Head
Phone:
9444310236
Email:
hodmech@avit.ac.in
LinkedIn:
Dr. M. Prabhahar
Qualification
Dr.M. Prabhahar has received his B.E. Mechanical engineering degree from the Manonmaniam Sundaranar University Tirunelveli, in 2002, Master’s in CAD/CAM from Anna University, in 2004 and MBA (Systems) from Alagappa University, Karaikudi in the year 2006. He obtained his Ph.D. from the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering, St.Peters University, Chennai in October 2012.
Research Interests
He has been in the teaching field since 2004 and actively involved in the innovating newer methods in pedagogical process. He has guided various UG and PG projects and also guides Ph.D. students since 2015. Under his guidance 4 research scholars have completed PhD and currently 4 scholars are pursuing Ph.D. His assiduous and prolific research work has earned him very good reputation in the field of bio alternate fuels. He has over 90 plus publications in highly reputed international journals, 34 papers in international and national conferences. As a boon to his active research, he was granted 3 patents. His main research area of interests includes Alternative fuels, LHR engines, IC Engine Performance and Assessment.
He is a Doctoral Committee member of PhD Scholars of many universities such as Anna University, Bharat Institute of Higher Education and Research, Dr.M.G.R Educational and Research Institute, St.Peter’s Institute of Higher Education and Research.
He has two text books, “Unconventional Machining Processes” and “Basics of Civil and Mechanical Engineering” to his credit which were published in the years 2015 and 2017 respectively.
He was a member of several technical executive committees on National and International conferences and potential reviewer of several journals, reviewing minimum four papers per month. He also delivered several guest lectures, invited talks, seminars and chaired session for various Conferences across the country. His research paper “Modeling and construction of bio diesel processor”, has been selected for the cover note article for the Global Journal of Research in Engineering, USA, Dec 2010.
He is the Editorial Board Member for the Journal of Transportation Management, En Press Publications, USA. Also, he is extending his meritorious service of being referee of many reputed journals. He is a member of professional bodies such as INSc, IAEng and ISTE.
Awards and Recognitions
Recipient of Research Excellence Award 2021 awarded by Institute of Scholars.
Awarded as a recognized reviewer by Elsevier journals reviewer Hub.
Recipient of “NPTEL Star” – “NPTEL Motivated Learners award, April 2022.
Recipient of Mentor appreciation certificate from Swayam, NPTEL.
Instrumental for the inauguration of NIQR Professional Society Chapter at AVIT.

Institution Level: Head Exam cell, Convener Graduation Day, Convener – Alternative fuels research Centre, Core Committee member-UGC/Statutory Bodies.

Mechanical Engineering Department Highlights at AVIT
Discover academic, technical, and research highlights of the Mechanical Engineering department at AVIT showcasing innovation and excellence.
Department of Mechanical Engineering - Highlights
Mission & Vision
Research Facilities
Mission
Centre of Excellence for Alternate Fuels is an important research community that expands the visibility of research understanding and findings. It aims to create the awareness to the research fraternity about the alternative fuels derived from organic matters (vegetable substance). Since, biofuels derived from organic matters has played a vital role in the environmental issues to reduce the harmful automobile emissions.
Vision
Centre of Research for Alternate Fuels is dedicated to develop advanced concepts and methods for performance analysis of bio fuelled IC engines, and pursuing solutions through wide-ranging industrial collaborations, discussions and seminars. The center is committed to achieving its mission using innovative science, technology, education and Management, strategies having high impact for all stakeholders.

Consultancy Brochure
Bosch Automotive Research Lab:
Bosch Limited, the German automaker, announced on collaboration with Aarupadai Veedu Institute Of Technology, it has launched a training centre in Chennai. The joint certification center is located inside the premises of Aarupadai Veedu Institute Of Technology. The Center has been equipped with Bosch Equipment, such as, Test Bench, Auto Electrical Test Bench, Diagnostic Scanner and A/C recovery, Evacuation and Recycling Machine. The training center will provide joint certification programs to students of Aarupadai Veedu Institute Of Technology, technicians and service personnel alike. On an average 100 training programs will be conducted every year. Bosch has been providing training services to thousands of technicians, service personnel, and lately, educational institutions for over a decade.Training courses from the Group offer knowledge of the evolving technologies, and at the same time provide hands-on experience with the latest equipment.

Professional Society
Energy and Fuel Users Association of India(ENFUSE)
Energy & Fuel Users' Association of India(ENFUSE) is a National Body representing a wide spectrum of Indian Organisations who are producers and users of all forms of Energy and Fuel, including, Building Sector,Chemicals,Textiles Tyre industries besides the core sector of power, petroleum and steel. Formed in 1950 as voluntary and non-profit organisation, ENFUSE seeks to maximze the effectiveness of energy and fuel usage, particularly in the industrial sector, and thus contribute to Nation's industrial development by playing the role of catalyst and advisor. ENFUSE is committed for continued awareness on efficient energy management and conducts focused.

National Institution for Quality and Reliability (NIQR)
NIQR came into existence in July 1987 with the amalgamation of National Institution of Quality Assurance and Indian Association of Quality and Reliability. National Institution for Quality and reliability is administrated by a National Executive Council functioning at the National Head Quarters at Chennai, Tamil Nadu and Executive Committee at various Branches. Leading Industrialists, Top Level officers / Executives, Managers, Professionals and Academia elected through a democratic process with appropriate representation are the Members of the Executive Council and Branch Executive Committees. NIQR is playing a key role in National Quality Movement as a Board Member of NBQP and also Governing Council Member of Quality Council of India (QCI), which is playing a pivotal role in promoting, adopting and adhering to quality standards in all important spheres of activities at National level.

Association of Mechanical Engineers of AVIT- (AMEA)
Association of Mechanical Engineers of AVIT (AMEA) an Actively Functional Body Under the Department Mechanical Engineering. This Association is conducting several activities in the department for benefit of the students. Every Mechanical Engineering student beginning with the second year in the program at AVIT is a member of AMEA. Qualification
Dr.L.Chitra, a dedicated, resourceful and goal-driven professional educator with a solid commitment to the social and academic growth and development of every student has completed her Bachelor degree in Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering at National Engineering College, Kovilpatti followed by a Master’s degree in Power Electronics and Drives at Raja College of Engineering and Technology, Madurai. She has completed her doctorate in the area of MEMS Sensor technology at Sathyabama Institute of Science and Technology, Chennai. She has a rich teaching experience of 22 years.

Electrical Engineering Department Highlights at AVIT
View academic and technical highlights of the Electrical and Electronics Engineering department showcasing projects, research, and student achievements.
Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Highlights
Mission & Vision
Research Facilities
Mission
To provide industry with advanced consultancy services in automation, plant design, and system optimization, leveraging the latest technologies
To create a collaborative environment where industry professionals and researchers can pioneer solutions that enhance operational efficiency and innovation in real-world applications
To serve as a bridge between academic research and industrial needs, offering practical, scalable solutions that address complex challenges in manufacturing, power, and energy management sectors.
Vision
To be a transformative hub for industry-leading research and consultancy, driving the future of automation, digitalization, and process optimization across sectors through cutting-edge technology and innovative solutions

Activities
1. The Department of EEE, in association with the AVIT Alumni Association and IEI, organized a three-day Employability Enhancement Course on “Sustainable Energy and Clean Technology” from 24–26 June 2022. The program began with a guest lecture on solar energy concepts and measurement techniques.
Students then visited Inforce Solar Company to learn about solar PV installation and design procedures.
They also visited Anna Nagar West Metro Station to understand real-time on-grid solar power generation.
The program provided students with valuable hands-on exposure to solar power plant installation and sustainable energy practices.
2. The Department of EEE organized a two-week Hybrid ATAL Faculty Development Program on “Digital Twin for Electric Vehicles” from 12–23 September 2022. Experts from Malaysia, Thailand, Anna University, NIT Durgapur, Daimler AG, Siemens, and industry delivered sessions on EV design, charging technology, IoT, digitalization, and MATLAB/Simulink applications. The program included hands-on industrial visits to GIEC, AV Campus and Tri Electric Pvt. Ltd., providing exposure to EV components and manufacturing. Participants gained insights into digital twin concepts, EV modelling, battery systems, Industry 4.0, and research methodologies. The FDP concluded with a valedictory session and certificate distribution, marking a highly successful academic and industry-integrated program.
3. ISTE–AVIT, in association with the Department of EEE, organized a “Design Thinking Contest” on 13.09.2022 to celebrate Engineers’ Day. Students proposed innovative solutions for ten social issues given on the spot after a briefing on design thinking. The best teams were awarded certificates and prizes for their creative ideas.
4. The Department of EEE, in association with the AVIT Alumni Association, organized a Skill Development Program on E-Mobility on 20.09.2022, featuring alumnus Mr. Anil Chourasia, Senior R&D Engineer, Daimler-AG. He delivered an in-depth session covering EV design considerations, battery systems, safety measures, and harness design for electric vehicles. Forty students from EEE and Mechatronics actively participated and gained valuable insights into emerging E-mobility technologies.
5. On 27.09.2022, the Climate Hackathon Challenge motivated students to explore innovative ideas to combat climate change through seven creative tasks. Participants designed climate clocks, proposed solutions for industries, institutions, and individuals, and expressed climate awareness through songs, drama, and T-shirt art. The event fostered creativity, responsibility, and a strong commitment toward environmental sustainability.
6. The Department of EEE celebrated National Energy Conservation Day on 14.12.2022 with great enthusiasm. A seminar on Innovation in Energy Conservation Technologies was conducted to enhance students’ knowledge on modern energy-saving methods. Students also presented posters to create awareness about energy conservation at the domestic level.
7. A special lecture on Fabrication of Electric Bikes of Different Capacities was conducted on 11.02.2023 for EEE and Mechatronics students. Mr. Gav Boomi from SVNIT, Surat explained EV norms, motor and battery selection, controller types, chassis design, weight considerations, and overall bike design. Students also received hands-on exposure with a fabricated electric bicycle, making the session highly informative and practical.
8. The Department of EEE, in association with the Institution of Engineers and Power Projects, conducted an Employability Enhancement Course on “Application of DCS in Industrial Automation” from 09.05.2023 to 13.05.2023.Students learned key concepts such as PLC vs DCS, process control, DCS architecture, redundancy, HMI/SCADA, and the evolution of automation, followed by hands-on industrial training at Infercon Automation Pvt. Ltd., Chennai.A total of 22 students from EEE and Mechatronics participated, gaining valuable practical exposure to industrial automation systems.
9. The Department of EEE and the Adhavan Energy Swaraj Club organized a “Climate Clock Assembly” event on 19.08.2023 for school and polytechnic students. A total of 231 students participated and learned about climate change and renewable energy. A hands-on session was conducted to assemble the climate clock, and the completed models were handed over to the respective institutions.
10. The Department of EEE, in association with the IIC, celebrated Renewable Energy Day on 22.08.2023 with a brainstorming session and the idea-pitching event “Pitch It Perfect.” Students actively participated, preparing pitch decks on renewable energy innovations. Five shortlisted teams presented ideas on smart energy use, battery management, and energy meters. Two teams were selected as winners and were felicitated with certificates.
11. The Department of EEE, in association with the Institute Innovation Council and APJ Abdul Kalam Aero Vehicle Innovation Technology Club, celebrated Innovation Day on 18–19 October 2023. Various technical exhibits, model/poster presentations, and activity-based learning events were conducted across departments. Students actively participated in quizzes, hands-on activities, and idea-pitching competitions, showcasing innovative projects like self-charging e-bikes, AI-based solutions, and ISRO-themed models. Winners from each event were felicitated with certificates, promoting creativity and interdisciplinary learning.
12. The Department of EEE, AVIT, organized a DST-SERB sponsored five-day national seminar on “Digital Twin for Sustainable Energy Management” from 1st to 5th April 2024. Experts, including Dr. L. Chitra and industry leaders, delivered sessions on Digital Twin concepts, DCS, IIoT, and hands-on training in Comos Lab. Participants gained insights into real-time monitoring, optimization, and sustainable energy solutions through interactive lectures and practical exercises. The seminar concluded with a valedictory function and certificate distribution, recognizing the active engagement of all attendees.
13. The Department organized an Advanced Faculty Development Programme (FDP) on “Digital Twin for Smart Manufacturing: Applications and Its Challenges” from November 25 to December. The programme focused on recent advancements, industrial applications, and emerging challenges in digital twin technology. Faculty participants gained valuable insights into smart manufacturing practices and future research opportunities.
14. The Department of EEE organized a Skill Development Program titled “ELECTROCRAFTS – Fundamental to Future” on 28.03.2025 at the Digital Electronics & Microcontroller Lab. More than 20 student teams showcased innovative microprojects based on core electrical engineering concepts. The event promoted hands-on learning, creativity, and practical understanding among undergraduate students.
15. The Department of EEE and AVIT Alumni Association conducted an Alumni Guest Workshop on “Efficient Battery Cell Packaging” on 27 July 2025 at the Siemens Integrated Engineering Lab. Mr. R. Anandhan, alumnus and ISMO Bio-photonics expert, explained advanced battery storage technologies, thermal management, and modern packaging methods. Around 35 students benefited from the interactive session, gaining insights into innovations in energy systems and electric mobility.
16. The Department of EEE organized a guest lecture by Mr. Shebeer Mohammed, Founder & CEO of enRobosys Pvt. Ltd., who shared expert insights on energy storage systems and renewable energy integration.The session covered storage technologies, grid challenges, real-world applications, and future research opportunities, engaging around 45 student and faculty participants. The event concluded with a vote of thanks, appreciating the speaker and management for enabling an informative and interactive knowledge-sharing session.
17. The Department of EEE, AVIT, organized a two-day workshop on “Practical Insights into Grid-Connected Solar PV System” on 19–20 August 2025, featuring Mr. Devendra Singh from Ecosense Sustainable Solutions. Students received in-depth training on PV system design, grid synchronization, and later gained hands-on experience through experiments on solar modules and grid-integration setups. The workshop provided valuable practical exposure, strengthened understanding of renewable energy technologies, and received highly positive feedback from all participants.
18. The Department of EEE, in association with the AVIT Alumni Association, organized an Alumni Guest Lecture on “Corporate Ethics: Building Trust in a Competitive World” on 12 September 2025, delivered by alumnus Mr. Vignesh T from IQVIA, Chennai. He shared his corporate experiences and emphasized the importance of ethics, integrity, teamwork, and trust-building in achieving long-term professional success. The interactive session was well-received and motivated students to adopt strong ethical values and prepare for real-world corporate challenges.
19. The Department of EEE organized a one-day workshop on “Advancements in Fuel Cell Technology for Academic Research,” featuring Mr. Ajay Rai from Ecosense Sustainable Solutions, New Delhi. The session covered advanced catalysts, improved electrolytes, hydrogen storage, system durability, renewable integration, and simulation tools, along with an online demonstration. With over 23 participants, the workshop provided valuable insights into cutting-edge fuel cell technologies and their applications in academic research.
20. A team of 11 EEE students visited the Siemens Gamesa Renewable Energy facility in Nellore on 26.08.2025, where they received safety instructions and an overview of the wind turbine blade manufacturing process. They learned about advanced models like the SG 3.4-145 and G114-2.0 MW, modular design features, AEP improvements, and additional products such as converters, generators, and control cabinets. The visit concluded with guidance from senior officials, who emphasized skill development and conceptual learning for future professional growth.
21. The Department of EEE, AVIT, organized its school-level technical symposium “EDU CLUSTERS 2K25” on 14 October 2025, providing a vibrant platform for students to showcase creativity, innovation, and technical skills. Over 300 students from various schools participated in events such as Robot Race, Tech Expo, Tech Quiz, App Pitch, and several cultural activities, creating an energetic and engaging atmosphere across the campus. The symposium concluded with a valedictory ceremony, where St. Mary’s Matriculation Higher Secondary School, Mamallapuram, won the overall championship trophy.

Head of Electronics and Communication Engineering at AVIT
Know more about the Head of the Electronics and Communication Engineering department and their role in academic leadership and department development.
HOD Electronics and Communication Engineering
Dr. Kavitha B C
Dr. Kavitha B.C heads the Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering at
Aarupadai Veedu Institute of Technology with 22 years of teaching, research, academic
administration and industry collaborations.
Professor and Head
Email:
kavitha.avec0102@avit.ac.in
LinkedIn:
https://www.linkedin.com/in/b-c-kavitha-635831104/
Qualification
Dr.KavithaB C received her Ph.D. in Fault Identification and Data Management in IoT Mobile Edge Environments from Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science. Prior to her doctorate, she completed Master of Engineering in Communication Systems from Anna University andB.Tech in Electronics Engineering from Cochin University of Science and Technology.
Awards and Recognitions
Dr.Kavitha B C is an active member of IET and life time member of IETE. Her professional excellence is marked by several accolades, including the Best Faculty Award and an Encouragement Award from HITS in 2021. She has been granted 2 Australian patents for her work on Industrial IoT Data Management and Mammogram Image Analysis for cancer detection. Additionally, she received a Best Paper Award at the 60th IETE Annual Convention and a Patent Award in 2023. She has around 30 research publications and over 212 total citations.
Publications
Dr.Kavitha B C has a robust publication record with over 30 Scopus-indexed documents, including high-impact journal articles, book chapters and conference papers. Her research covers diverse topics such as 5G-IoT path loss modelling, Pollution monitoring using Raspberry-Pi and Machine learning for Industrial Automation. She has also authored book chapters for Springer Nature concerning Fault detection and Predictive Maintenance in the IIoT sector. Her collaborative conference work includes innovative projects like Brain-wave controlled wheelchairsand Smart wearable devices for the blind.

Hardware Security Research Lab
Hardware-Security Lab is a premier destination for cutting-edge consultancy services in hardware security. With state-of-the-art facilities and a team of experienced faculty members, this lab is committed to provide comprehensive solutions tailored for all the security needs. This lab facilitates from threat analysis to secure design methodologies, and offer guidance and support to help mitigating risks and protect the system.
Vision Statement:
To be a globally recognized leader in hardware security research, driving innovation and shaping the future of secure hardware systems through groundbreaking research, collaboration, and excellence.
Mission Statement:
To advance the state-of-the-art in hardware security through cutting-edge research, interdisciplinary collaboration, and knowledge dissemination. We are committed to developing robust security solutions, empowering organizations to protect their assets and build trust in an increasingly interconnected world. Through our research, education, and industry partnerships, we strive to create a safer and more secure digital ecosystem for all.

Qualification
He holds a strong academic foundation in Civil Engineering, earning his undergraduate degree from the Government College of Technology, Coimbatore, followed by a Master’s in Structural Engineering from PSG College of Technology, Coimbatore. In 2016, he completed his Ph.D. in Civil Engineering from Anna University, Chennai, with a research focus on Seismic Resistant Structures. With over 19 years of teaching experience in leading engineering colleges across Tamil Nadu and Telangana, he has consistently inspired and shaped the next generation of engineers while making notable contributions to the academic community.

Concrete Technology, Structural Engineering, Seismic Resistant Structures and Rehabilitation of Structures.

Department of Civil - Highlights
Research Facilities
Centre for Concrete Research and Testing
Mission
Our mission at Concrete Research and Testing Laboratory is to initiate and work with partners on fundamental research and then pursue and develop commercially viable solutions that address the needs of owners, developers, architects and Engineers.
Vision
Concrete Research and Testing Laboratory has significantly advanced the performance of concrete and driven the creation of new, innovative and cost-effective solutions that are making an impact today. Concrete Research and Testing Laboratory was founded in 2014 as the research and development division of civil engineering. During this time, we have engineered superior concrete mixes using alternative cement materials. These new mixes not only outperform traditional concrete mixes relative to set times and early strength, but significantly reduce the products carbon footprint. Many of these products have sprung from our Environmentally-Friendly Initiative.

Head of Biomedical Engineering Department at AVIT
Discover the role of the Head of the Biomedical Engineering department in academic planning, research development, and interdisciplinary learning.
HOD Biomedical
Dr. L. K. HEMA
Dr. L.K.HEMA is a competent Engineering Professional with 3 decades of diverse teaching experiences in Education and Training/Grooming with extensive experience in liaison with multi-disciplinary research activities.
Professor and Head
Email:
hodece@avit.ac.in
LinkedIn:
Dr. L. K. Hema
Qualification
In Educational front she pursued her B.E from Government College of Engineering, completed her Post Graduation in M.Tech (VLSI) & M.S (Education Management). She has acquired her Ph.D in the field of Wireless Sensor Network.
Awards and Recognitions
She is an active member in professional societies namely, IEEE, ISTE, IAWS. She has received the Best Research Grant Achiever Award from Vinayaka Mission’s Research Foundation and Best woman Achiever from Women Empowerment Cell, AVIT. She also received a funded project from DRDO, Delhi for the project titled “A Comprehensive Study on Hardware Trojans- Challenges and Solutions “. She has also completed a funded project received from MHRD-Unnat Bharath Abhiyann titled “Digital marketing App for Rural People”. She has received the Uttama Adhyapika Award from Bharat Education Excellence Awards.
Publications
Her research expertise are in the field of Hardware security, Wireless sensor Network, VLSI design and Biomedical Device Development. She has published more than 45 papers in Refereed International Journals and International Conferences. She has been granted with one patent, published 5 patents and 2 books titled Embedded Systems and Information Storage Management.

Dr. A. NIRMALA
, joined as a lecture in 2008. Later, she was promoted to Assistant Professor (Gr-II), and she is currently working as Associate Professor and Head in the Department of Biotechnology, Aarupadai Veedu Institute of Technology, Chennai.

Dr. Nirmala Arunachalam
Qualification
She obtained her Ph.D. degree from the University of Madras, Chennai, in 2018, a Master of Philosophy from the Avinashilingam Institute for Home Science and Higher Education for Women, Coimbatore, Gold Medalist in the Master degree achieved from Gandhigram Rural Institute, Gandhigram, undergraduate from Madurai Kamaraj University, and a Post Graduate Diploma in Bioinformatics obtained from Bharathiyar University, Coimbatore.
Awards and Recognitions
She is a recipient of a TICA fellowship and attended a one-month training program on “Tropical Medicine, Community Health Care and Research”, Khon Kaen University, Khon Kaen, Thailand, funded by the Thai Government. She received funds from the Tamil Nadu State Council for Science and Technology (TNSCST).
Publications
She has 17 years of experience. She has published 5 book chapters, 25 papers in various national and international journals, presented scientific papers at national / international conferences, and also attended more than 200 webinars in the area of biotechnology and bioscience. She is a doctoral committee member at Veltech University, Chennai. Her area of research includes diabetes mellitus, biochemical studies, medicinal plants, and phytochemical analysis. She is a member of various professional societies like the Society for Biotechnologists, Life Member of the Indian Science Congress Association, Life Member of the Indian Society for Technical Education, Life Member in the International Association of Engineers and a Life member of the Institute for Science, Engineering and Technology Research. She has coordinated many guest lectures, seminars, national and international conferences. She is proficiently motivating the students to participate in seminars, national and international conferences and idea submissions in hackathons.

Biotechnology Department Highlights and Activities
Explore academic achievements, research activities, and departmental highlights of Biotechnology at AVIT focusing on innovation and life sciences.
Department of Biotechnology Highlights
Research Facilities
Centre for Plant Tissue Culture & Bioprocess Engineering
Mission
To produce exact copies of plants with desirabletraits in large scale within short period of time. To maintain and establish virus free, disease free stocks. To cross distantly related species by protoplastfusion and regeneration of novelhybrid. To rapidly develop and study on molecularbasis for physiological, biochemical and reproductive mechanisms in plants for stress tolerantspecies. To regenerate transgenic plants of desirable characters. To produce identical sterile hybridspecies To conserve rare or endangered plantspecies.
Vision
To disseminate the knowledge and skill to students and develop entrepreneurs in plant tissue culture to meet the green demands of the day by day increasing population.
Infrastructure
Infrastructure
Centre for Plant Tissue Culture and Bioprocessing
Worldwide Plant tissue culture technique is being utilized as an imperative tool to meet green economy of the country. Plantlets are grown in large number from isolated cells or tissues under sterile and controlled conditions outside the parent plant. Plant Tissue Culture Lab provides the facility of growing large number of isolated cells or tissues under sterile and controlled conditions obtained from any part of the plant like stem, root, leaf etc. which are encouraged to produce more cells in culture and to express their totipotency (i.e., their genetic ability to produce more plants). Cells or tissues are grown in different types of glass vials containing a medium with mineral nutrients, vitamins and phyto-hormones. Tissue Culture techniques are being exploited in this laboratory to multiply plants which are difficult to propagate by conventional means. The Centre was established in the month of March 2012 under Department of Biotechnology, Govt. of India under a funded project entitled “Large scale production of 4- ipomeanol an anti cancer agent”
Facilities available in the Centre
An aseptic transfer area
Media preparation and sterilization area
Environmentally controlled incubators or culture room
Data collection area

Graduation Day 2025
Graduation Day 2025
20th September 2025
2025
22nd Graduation day
DATE
20th September 2025
TIME
2.00 p.m.
VENUE
Indoor Auditorium, AVIT
Register Now
Special Instructions
Candidates are directed to bring proof of identity.
Candidates are requested to register their presence in the campus and enrollment in the AVIT Campus between 9.00 a.m. and 12.00 noon (including those registered online).
Candidates should sit in the allotted seats by 1.30pm sharp with formal dress, shoes, robe and hood. Students with informal dress will not be permitted into the Graduation Hall.
All Graduands will remain standing when the academic procession enters the hall and shall take their seats only after the members of the procession are seated.
After receiving degree certificates, candidates shall go back to their respective seats and remain seated maintaining utmost discipline.
After receiving the degree, students recite the pledge to support the values of our University community.
When the graduation function is over, all shall remain standing in their places till the procession leaves the hall.
Candidates are directed not to bring Cellular phones and Cameras to the Graduation Hall.
Children are not permitted inside the Graduation Hall.
Only one Parent/Guardian shall accompany the Graduands.
Separate Mini Auditorium & Digital Classrooms are arranged for parents to witness the Graduation Ceremony.
Registration
Registration for Graduands
Registration: 9.00 A.M. to 12.00 noon
Registration beyond 12.00 noon will not be entertained
Registration Fee: Rs.1000/-
Candidates are directed to bring 1 Passport Size photograph
Help Desk: Near Central Stores, Thiruvalluvar Block
Robe
Robes and hood have to be hired from the authorized counter located near Soil Mechanics Lab by giving a refundable caution deposit of Rs.500/-.
Transport
All the College buses will ply on the usual routes. Candidates & Parents attending the Graduation day, may board the buses. Check the Bus timings and routes in https://old.avit.ac.in/transport1/

Only official photographers will be allowed to take photographs during the ceremony

About WEC
About Women Empowerment Cell:
The Institution has established a Women Empowerment Cell (WEC) in the college campus to empower and safeguard the rights of female members; faculty, staff and students The WEC works to promote gender equality in the campus and conduct diverse programmes to educate, sensitize both male and female members and produce harmonious atmosphere on the campus. Aiming at intellectual and social upliftment of the female students and staffs, the cell stands for facilitating women’s empowerment through guest lectures, seminars, awareness programmes and other welfare activities.
Objectives of the Cell:
1. Identification and building of strong leadership among women faculty and students.
2. To create a secure physical and social environment to deter any act of sexual harassment.
3. To promote a culture of respect and equality for female gender.
4. To make them aware about the guidelines of Supreme Court and to ensure that sexual harassment is treated as an unacceptable social behaviour within the institution and the society.
5. To organise skill development programs for the rural women to enhance their livelihood, also to help them to identify the sources of financial support.
6. To conduct seminar, workshop to impart knowledge of opportunities and tools available and train the women.
7. To inculcate entrepreneurial attitude among young girls, so that they can be “job providers” rather than “job seekers”.

In addition Ms. Monika Sharma of III year civil was awarded for her achievements in the visual media and Ms. Rachel Hephzibah of III year B. Arch was awarded for her innovations in the field of Architecture and design. Dr. M Ponnavaiko, the Provost of Vinayaka Missions Research Foundation gave the felicitation. Prizes for the events conducted as part of the Women’s day celebration were distributed to students and Faculty. Dr. R. Shanmugavalli, Director of FAS delivered the Vote of Thanks.
A woman is an epitome of beauty, wisdom and care. She has climbed the mountains and dived into the ocean; she has matched the steps with every man in the world. International Women’s Day celebrates the power of women – their rights and role in our lives and society. Having stated this, let us now focus on the Women’s Day celebration at AVIT, Paiyanoor. Our Management takes pride in making women employees feel special not only on Women’s Day but also on every other day. On the 8th of March 2019, a grand event was conducted to accentuate this fact. The Chief Guest for this event was the Honourable Chancellor of VMRF, Dr. A. S. Ganesan and the Special Guest was Dr. Anuradha Ganesan, Director for VMRF. The event honoured the VMRF Women of Excellence Awardees – Dr. Kamala Selvaraj (Gynecologist & Obstetrician, GEE GEE Super Specialty Hospital), Ms. Anu Khosla (Outstanding Scientist, Director SAG, DRDO) and Mrs. Vanitha (IPS Cadre, Deputy General of Police, Vellore Range). Principal Dr. P. Shankar welcomed the gathering.The other distinguished dignitaries were Provost of VMRF Dr. M. Ponnavaikko, Director Dr. S. A. V. Satyamoorthy, ,AdvisorMr.SureshSamuel,Vice Principals and Head Operations Mr.Srinivasan.
“The best way to change society and the underlying issues is to channelize the power of women in every walk of life.”
>> The Women’s Empowerment Cell Newsletter was released at this event. Thereafter, the ‘VMRF Women’s Leadership’ Award was given to Dr.GiriRengasamy,Dean CSR and Dr.Prabhavathy,COE,VMRFfor her outstanding contribution in the field of academic team management. The AVIT ‘Exceptional Mother’ Award was presented to three mothers of our students for being a selfless example for mothers all over the state. The ‘VMRF Exceptional Girl Student’ award was bagged by Ms.A.Keerthana, III BCA,Ms.PoojaLal, IV year ECE and Ms.Sivaranjani of II year SAE fortheir exceptionally commendable academic and co curricularrecords. Following this, the faculty and student awards were distributed. Finally, in the Vote of Thanks, Dr. S. P. Sangeetha, WEC Coordinator and Vice Principal of Academics thanked the event organisers and the audience for making the event a memorable occasion.

B.E. Computer Science and Engineering
Build the skills to design, develop, and deploy software systems that power the digital world- from web and mobile applications to AI-enabled enterprise platforms. The B.E. CSE programme at AVIT combines strong engineering fundamentals with modern software development, AI, cloud computing, and cybersecurity.
Apply Now
Download Curriculum
PROGRAMME OVERVIEW
Engineering the Intelligent Technologies of Tomorrow
Computer Science and Engineering at AVIT empowers students to become innovators, problem-solvers, and technology leaders in a rapidly evolving digital world. The programme blends strong foundations in programming, algorithms, software engineering, and intelligent systems with specialized pathways in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, Data Science, Cyber Security, Cloud Computing, and Quantum Computing.
Through advanced laboratories, industry certifications, internships, hackathons, coding competitions, research projects, patent development, startup incubation, and collaborations with leading technology partners, students gain real-world experience and future-ready skills. Supported by expert faculty, modern learning infrastructure, and a vibrant innovation ecosystem, AVIT CSE prepares graduates for successful careers in software development, AI, data science, cybersecurity, cloud technologies, research, and entrepreneurship.

PROGRAMME HIGHLIGHTS
What You'll Achieve with Us
Engineering Graduates will be able to:
Apply the knowledge of mathematics, science, engineering fundamentals, and an engineering specialization to the solution of complex engineering problems.
Identify, formulate, review research literature, and analyze complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions using first principles of mathematics, natural sciences, and engineering sciences.
Design solutions for complex engineering problems and design system components or processes that meet the specified needs with appropriate consideration for the public health and safety, and the cultural, societal, and environmental considerations.
Use research-based knowledge and research methods including design of experiments, analysis and interpretation of data, and synthesis of the information to provide valid conclusions.
Create, select, and apply appropriate techniques, resources, and modern engineering and IT tools including prediction and modeling to complex engineering activities with an understanding of the limitations.
Apply reasoning informed by the contextual knowledge to assess societal, health, safety, legal and cultural issues and the consequent responsibilities relevant to the professional engineering practice.
Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics and responsibilities and norms of the engineering practice.
Function effectively as an individual, and as a member or leader in diverse / multidisciplinary teams.
Communicate effectively and inclusively within the engineering community and society at large, such as being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation, make effective presentations considering cultural, language, and learning differences.
Apply knowledge and understanding of engineering management principles and economic decision-making and apply these to one's own work, as a member and leader in a team, and to manage projects and in multidisciplinary environments.
Recognize the need for, and have the preparation and ability for i) independent and life-long learning ii) adaptability to new and emerging technologies and iii) critical thinking in the broadest context of technological change.
Graduating Students of Computer Science and Engineering programme will be able to:
PSO 1
Demonstrate understanding of the principles and working of the hardware and software aspects of computer systems.
PSO 2
Understand, analyze and develop computer programs in the areas related to algorithms, system software, multimedia, web design, big data analytics and networking for efficient design of computer-based systems of varying complexity.
PSO 3
Apply standard Software Engineering practices and strategies in software project development using open-source programming environment to deliver a quality product for business success and to be acquainted with the contemporary issues, latest trends in technological development and thereby innovate new ideas and solutions to existing problems.
Implement fundamental domain knowledge of core courses for developing effective computing solutions by incorporating creativity and logical reasoning.
Graduate will establish effective professionals by solving real world problems using investigative and analytical skills along with the knowledge acquired in the field of Computer Science and Engineering.
Graduate will prove ability to work and communicate effectively as a team member and/or leader to complete the task with minimal resources, meeting deadlines.
Graduate will demonstrate his/her ability to adapt to rapidly changing environment in advanced areas of Computer Science and scale new heights in their profession through lifelong learning.

AVIT CSE (AI & ML) combines an industry-aligned curriculum, future-focused AI specializations, advanced AI research labs, internships, certifications, research opportunities, hackathons, and strong placement support to prepare students for successful careers in artificial intelligence and machine learning.
Students master machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, natural language processing, data mining, generative AI, and cloud AI platforms, along with strong foundations in programming, mathematics, and data engineering.
Students benefit from collaborations with Intel, NEC, HCLTech, PRB Consulting Pvt. Ltd., and XTIC (IIT Madras), along with AI and cloud certifications, internships, industry projects, expert talks, and hands-on learning experiences.

Yes. Students actively participate in internships, national and international hackathons, coding competitions, AI research projects, patent development, innovation challenges, and startup incubation programs.

PROGRAMME OVERVIEW
Engineering the Defenders of the Digital World
B.E. Computer Science and Engineering (Cyber Security) at AVIT empowers students to become security engineers, ethical hackers, and digital defenders in a world where data and infrastructure are under constant threat. The programme blends strong foundations in programming, algorithms, operating systems, and networks with specialized expertise in ethical hacking, network security, digital forensics, cryptography, Security Operations Centre (SOC) practices, and cloud security.
Through advanced security laboratories, industry certifications, internships, capture-the-flag (CTF) competitions, research projects, and collaborations with leading technology partners, students gain hands-on experience in identifying vulnerabilities, defending systems, and responding to incidents. Supported by expert faculty, modern learning infrastructure, and a vibrant innovation ecosystem, AVIT prepares graduates for high-demand careers in cyber security analysis, security engineering, threat intelligence, forensics, research, and entrepreneurship.

PROGRAMME HIGHLIGHTS
What You'll Achieve with Us
Engineering Graduates will be able to:
Apply the knowledge of mathematics, science, engineering fundamentals, and an engineering specialization to the solution of complex engineering problems.
Identify, formulate, review research literature, and analyze complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions using first principles of mathematics, natural sciences, and engineering sciences.
Design solutions for complex engineering problems and design system components or processes that meet the specified needs with appropriate consideration for the public health and safety, and the cultural, societal, and environmental considerations.
Use research-based knowledge and research methods including design of experiments, analysis and interpretation of data, and synthesis of the information to provide valid conclusions.
Create, select, and apply appropriate techniques, resources, and modern engineering and IT tools including prediction and modeling to complex engineering activities with an understanding of the limitations.
Apply reasoning informed by the contextual knowledge to assess societal, health, safety, legal and cultural issues and the consequent responsibilities relevant to the professional engineering practice.
Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics and responsibilities and norms of the engineering practice.
Function effectively as an individual, and as a member or leader in diverse / multidisciplinary teams.
Communicate effectively and inclusively within the engineering community and society at large, such as being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation, make effective presentations considering cultural, language, and learning differences.
Apply knowledge and understanding of engineering management principles and economic decision-making and apply these to one's own work, as a member and leader in a team, and to manage projects and in multidisciplinary environments.
Recognize the need for, and have the preparation and ability for i) independent and life-long learning ii) adaptability to new and emerging technologies and iii) critical thinking in the broadest context of technological change.
Graduating Students of Computer Science and Engineering programme will be able to:
PSO 1
Demonstrate understanding of the principles and working of the hardware and software aspects of computer systems.
PSO 2
Understand, analyze and develop computer programs in the areas related to algorithms, system software, multimedia, web design, big data analytics and networking for efficient design of computer-based systems of varying complexity.
PSO 3
Apply standard Software Engineering practices and strategies in software project development using open-source programming environment to deliver a quality product for business success and to be acquainted with the contemporary issues, latest trends in technological development and thereby innovate new ideas and solutions to existing problems.
Implement fundamental domain knowledge of core courses for developing effective computing solutions by incorporating creativity and logical reasoning.
Graduate will establish effective professionals by solving real world problems using investigative and analytical skills along with the knowledge acquired in the field of Computer Science and Engineering.
Graduate will prove ability to work and communicate effectively as a team member and/or leader to complete the task with minimal resources, meeting deadlines.
Graduate will demonstrate his/her ability to adapt to rapidly changing environment in advanced areas of Computer Science and scale new heights in their profession through lifelong learning.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Common Questions About B.E. CSE (Data Science)
AVIT's Data Science programme combines an industry-aligned curriculum, hands-on analytics projects, advanced laboratories, internships, certifications, research opportunities, hackathons, and strong placement support to prepare students for successful data-driven careers.
Students master programming, statistics, data structures, database systems, data visualization, big data analytics, predictive modelling, data mining, business analytics, machine learning, and cloud-based data platforms.
Students benefit from collaborations with Intel, NEC, HCLTech, and XTIC (IIT Madras), along with analytics certifications, internships, industry projects, expert talks, and hands-on data-driven learning experiences.
Graduates can pursue careers as Data Scientists, Data Analysts, Business Intelligence Analysts, Data Engineers, Big Data Engineers, Analytics Consultants, Researchers, and Entrepreneurs.
Yes. Students actively participate in internships, national and international hackathons, analytics challenges, research projects, patent development, innovation challenges, and startup incubation programs.
The department provides access to the Intel Unnati & NEC Lab, Apple Authorized Training Centre, AI Research Lab, IoT Lab, Networking Lab, advanced computing facilities, and innovation-focused learning spaces for data-intensive work.
Yes. Students can pursue an Honors Degree in Big Data Engineering, specializations in Cloud Computing and Quantum Computing, and a Minor in Data Modeling Techniques based on curriculum regulations.
AVIT offers placement training, aptitude preparation, analytics and coding practice, mock interviews, industry mentoring, internships, and recruitment opportunities with leading product and service-based companies.
Absolutely. The programme prepares students for higher education, research careers, postgraduate studies, and doctoral programmes in data science and allied fields in India and abroad.
Students can apply through the AVIT admissions portal or contact the admissions office for guidance on eligibility, application procedures, scholarships, and programme selection.

RESEARCH OVERVIEW
A Research-Driven Department
The Research Facilities at the Department of Computer Science and Engineering, AVIT, are designed to foster innovation, interdisciplinary collaboration, and impactful technological advancements. The department provides a robust ecosystem equipped with state-of-the-art infrastructure, advanced computing resources, and dedicated research labs that support cutting-edge work in areas such as Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Cybersecurity, Embedded Systems, and Robotics.
With a strong emphasis on industry-aligned research and real-world problem solving, the facilities enable faculty and students to engage in high-quality research, funded projects, and collaborative initiatives with academic and industrial partners.

RESEARCH FOCUS
Research Focus Areas
At AVIT CSE, research is driven by innovation, industry relevance, and societal impact. Students and faculty actively engage in cutting-edge research across emerging technologies and interdisciplinary domains.
Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
Developing intelligent systems, predictive models, Generative AI applications, computer vision, and natural language processing solutions.
Data Science & Analytics
Leveraging big data, advanced analytics, visualization, and machine learning to solve complex real-world challenges.
Cyber Security & Digital Forensics
Advancing secure computing through ethical hacking, threat intelligence, blockchain security, digital forensics, and cyber resilience.
Cloud Computing & Distributed Systems
Exploring cloud-native architectures, edge computing, virtualization, distributed systems, and scalable computing platforms.
Quantum Computing & Emerging Technologies
Researching quantum algorithms, quantum machine learning, quantum cryptography, and next-generation computing paradigms.
Healthcare AI & Medical Image Analysis
Developing AI-powered diagnostic systems, disease prediction models, medical image analytics, and intelligent healthcare solutions.
Internet of Things (IoT) & Smart Systems
Designing intelligent connected systems for smart cities, healthcare, agriculture, transportation, and industrial automation.
Human-Centered & Responsible AI
Promoting ethical AI, explainable AI (XAI), trustworthy systems, accessibility, fairness, privacy, and responsible technology adoption.
Software Engineering & Intelligent Applications
Building scalable software solutions using modern engineering practices, automation, intelligent systems, and enterprise technologies.
Innovation, Patents & Entrepreneurship
Encouraging innovation-driven research, startup development, intellectual property creation, technology transfer, and impactful societal solutions.
Research Publications | Patents | Funded Projects | Industry Collaborations | Hackathons | Product Development | Startups & Innovation

International Association of Engineers
The seed for the Computer Society of India (CSI) was first shown in the year 1965 with a handful of IT enthusiasts who were a computer user group and felt the need to organize their activities. They also wanted to share their knowledge and exchange ideas on what they felt was a fast emerging sector. Today the CSI takes pride in being the largest and most professionally managed association of and for IT professionals in India. The purposes of the Society are scientific and educational directed towards the advancement of the theory and practice of computer science and IT.
The organisation has grown to an enviable size of 100,000 strong members consisting of professionals with varied backgrounds including Software developers, Scientists, Academicians, Project Managers, CIO's, CTO's & IT vendors to just name a few. It has spread its branches all over the country. Currently having 488 student branches and rooted firmly at 73 different locations, CSI has plans of opening many more chapters & activity centers in smaller towns and cities of the country. The idea is to spread the knowledge, and provide opportunities to as many interested as possible.
National Society of Professional Engineers
NSPE was established in 1934 to realize a simple but vital goal: create an inclusive, nontechnical organization dedicated to the interests of licensed professional engineers, regardless of practice area, that would protect engineers (and the public) from unqualified practitioners, build public recognition for the profession, and stand against unethical practices and inadequate compensation.

Life Beyond the Classroom
From AI hackathons to XR workshops, student life at AVIT CSE is driven by curiosity, collaboration, and real-world impact.
CLUBS & ORGANISATIONS
Join Vibrant Communities to Innovate, Lead and Grow
Our student-led clubs and professional societies provide opportunities to develop technical expertise, leadership skills, innovation mindset, teamwork, and industry exposure beyond the classroom.
AI Nexus Club
Explore Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Generative AI, Data Science, and emerging technologies through workshops, hackathons and innovation challenges. Hosts Netrix national symposium, industry expert sessions, and the national-level Intellecthon ideathon.
XR – Spectra Club
Explore the future of immersive technologies through Augmented Reality (AR), Virtual Reality (VR), Mixed Reality (MR), Digital Twins, Metaverse applications, and interactive 3D experiences. Spectra Club empowers students to innovate, design, and develop next-generation XR solutions through workshops, projects, hackathons, and industry-focused learning initiatives.
Coding & Competitive Programming Club
Develop problem-solving skills through coding contests, algorithmic challenges, hackathons, and programming competitions on national and global platforms.
Cyfence – Cyber Security Club
Learn ethical hacking, digital forensics, cyber defense, security awareness, and participate in Capture-the-Flag (CTF) competitions and cybersecurity workshops.
Data Science & Analytics Club
Work on real-world datasets, predictive analytics, visualization projects, AI applications, and data-driven problem-solving activities.

Student branch. Largest IT professionals association in India with 100,000+ members and 488 student branches nationwide.
NSPE- National Society of Professional Engineers
Established 1934. Dedicated to the interests of licensed professional engineers.

DEPARTMENT LEADERSHIP
Message from the Head of Department
HEAD OF DEPARTMENT
Dr. S. Balakrishnan
Professor and Head, Department of Computer Science and Engineering
Welcome, future innovators and problem solvers, to the vibrant community of Computer Science and Engineering! Whether you're diving into coding for the first time or honing your skills in advanced algorithms, you've embarked on a journey that will shape the future of technology.
In this dynamic field, curiosity is your compass, and creativity is your fuel. Together, we'll explore the endless possibilities of software development, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, and beyond.
Dr. S. Balakrishnan is Professor and Head of the Department of Computer Science and Engineering, Aarupadai Veedu Institute of Technology, Vinayaka Mission's Research Foundation (Deemed to be University), Paiyanoor, Chennai. He has 24 years of experience in teaching, research, and administration.
He has published over 39 books, 10 book chapters, 30 technical articles in CSI Communications Magazine, 27 technical blogs, 1 article in Electronics for You (EFY) magazine, 20 articles in Open Source for You Magazine, and over 150 publications in highly cited journals and conferences. He has completed 2 funded projects under the DST TIDE and CSRI schemes in AI applications.
His professional awards include the Iconic Teacher in Research Award at Symbiosis University of Applied Sciences, Indore; Best Patent Award from IEEE Madras Section (2024); Kalpa Acharya Award (Bharath Education Excellence Awards 2021–22); IEEE MAS Best Researcher Award (2022); AICTE Lilavati Award 2021–22; International Data Science Writer of the Year 2019 (Data Science Foundation UK); MTC Global Outstanding Researcher Award; Deloitte Innovation Award for Smart India Hackathon 2018; and Impactful Author of the Year 2017–18. He has acted as mentor, evaluator, and jury for Smart India Hackathon, MANTHAN, ASEAN-India Hackathon, and Toycathon, and received appreciation from the Ministry of Education's Innovation Cell for developing SIH alumni portals.
He has delivered 110+ guest lectures and seminars, 30+ keynote and invited addresses, and chaired 350+ sessions at national and international conferences. He serves as reviewer and editorial board member for reputed journals and as a technical program committee member for conferences worldwide. His research interests include artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and IoT.
Dr. Balakrishnan has acted as mentor in the IndiaAI Fellowship under the IndiaAI Mission and in Kavach 2023 and Smart India Hackathon title-winning teams. He holds 14 granted international patents, 45 Indian patents on IoT applications, 22 design patent grants, and 3 granted copyrights, and was recognised in the India Book of Records 2021 for filing 18 patents in 15 months. He is an IEEE Senior Member and contributes to IEEE Teaching Excellence Hub, EduMentor Connect, and related ambassador programmes.

SOURCE: https://avit.ac.in/graduationday-2024
Graduation Day 2024 Celebrations at AVIT
Explore highlights and moments from the Graduation Day 2024 ceremony celebrating student achievements at AVIT.
Graduation Day
21st Graduation day
DATE
4th August 2024
TIME
2.00 p.m.
VENUE
Indoor Auditorium, AVIT
Register Now
Graduation day ceremony
Special Instructions
Candidates are directed to bring proof of identity.
Candidates are requested to register their presence in the campus and enrollment in the AVIT Campus between 9.00 a.m. and 12.00 noon (including those registered online).
Candidates should sit in the allotted seats by 1.30pm sharp with formal dress, shoes, robe and hood. Students with informal dress will not be permitted into the Graduation Hall.
All Graduands will remain standing when the academic procession enters the hall and shall take their seats only after the members of the procession are seated.
After receiving degree certificates, candidates shall go back to their respective seats and remain seated maintaining utmost discipline.
After receiving the degree, students recite the pledge to support the values of our University community.
When the graduation function is over, all shall remain standing in their places till the procession leaves the hall.
Candidates are directed not to bring Cellular phones and Cameras to the Graduation Hall.
Children are not permitted inside the Graduation Hall.
Only one Parent/Guardian shall accompany the Graduands.
Separate Digital Classrooms are arranged for parents to witness the Graduation Ceremony.
Registration
Registration for Graduands
Registration: 9.00 A.M. to 12.00 noon
Registration beyond 12.00 noon will not be entertained.
Registration Fee: Rs.1000/-
Candidates are directed to bring 1 Passport Size photograph.
Help Desk:
Near Central Stores, Thiruvalluvar Block
Robe
Robes and hood have to be hired from the authorized counter located near Soil Mechanics Lab by giving a refundable caution deposit of Rs.500/-.
Transport
All the College buses will ply on the usual routes. Candidates & Parents attending the Graduation day, may board the buses. Check the Bus timings and routes in https://avit.ac.in/transport1/
Special Buses are being operated from the following points until 10.00 A.M on 04-08-2024.
Sl.No | Route No | Station | Boarding point
1 | I | Kelambakkam | Opp.to.Police Station
2 | II | Thiruporur | Near Town Panchayath Office
3 | III | Poonjeri Junction(Near ECR) | Near Toll Gate
Photography
Authorized photographers will be available at the Graduation Hall from the morning of the Graduation Day and may be contacted by the candidates for their requirements of photograph.
Only official photographers will be allowed to take photographs during the ceremony
